architectural_decisions.title: Layered Architecture Guard & Pydantic Validation
architectural_decisions.summary: FastAPI routers strictly validate input with Pydantic v2 DTOs and delegate business logic to Domain Services. Direct DB queries in controllers are prohibited.

architectural_decisions.title: Redis Caching Layer & ARQ Background Task Worker
architectural_decisions.summary: Redis cache with graceful fallback for manga details and review aggregation. Heavy RapidOCR and NLP processing offloaded to asynchronous ARQ worker.

architectural_decisions.title: Hierarchical Page-First Panel Extraction Audit Reports
architectural_decisions.summary: Panel audit reports embed intact raw original page images as visual baseline followed by corresponding extracted crops, dialogues, and vocabulary badges.

architectural_decisions.title: Playwright Visual & Responsive Testing in Monorepo
architectural_decisions.summary: Playwright CLI testing across Desktop (1440px) and Mobile (375px) viewports integrated into frontend with zero horizontal overflow enforcement.

architectural_decisions.title: Automated Incremental CodeGraph Sync & Persistent Codebase Memory
architectural_decisions.summary: Git post-commit hook triggers incremental CodeGraph sync and updates codebase-memory.json to eliminate context amnesia and stale AST graphs.

architectural_decisions.title: Manga Reader Translation Studio & Isolated Engine Architecture
architectural_decisions.summary: Subprocess-isolated MangaTranslator execution plane, dedicated arq:translation queue, persistent page_uid identity, immutable profile revisions, and native React Studio workspace.
